name: Notification Channel
description: A label for grouping alerts (e.g. 'Safety', 'Battery Ops'). All Teams alerts are delivered to the single Naarni Teams webhook configured on the engine; these labels are for organising Alert Types, not separate destinations.

fields.label: Channel Name
fields.description: A friendly label, e.g. 'Safety', 'Battery Ops', 'Connectivity'. Pick it on an Alert Type to group/categorise it.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Delivery medium. Currently Microsoft Teams (single Naarni webhook).

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Uncheck to retire this label without deleting it.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Optional: what this label is for, who owns it, etc.
